raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On a hybrid-SWA model served with `--disable-radix-cache`, when the SWA pool is sized by `SWARequestCapPoolConfigurator`, a long prompt's chunks shrink after the second one. On MiMo-V2.6-Flash (window 128, `--chunked-prefill-size 4096`, `--max-running-requests 1`, overlap on), the SWA pool is 8,451 tokens. A 127,852-token prompt ran as 2 × 4,096 and then 258 and 3,968 alternating: 60 forwards instead of 32.

The cause is ordering. `PrefillAdder.add_chunked_req` sizes a continuing chunk from `SWAPrefillBudget.available_chunk_tokens`, which is the SWA pool's free count. At that point the previous chunk's out-of-window slots are still held: `ScheduleBatch.maybe_evict_swa` frees them only later, in `alloc_for_extend`. So when chunk 3 is sized, chunks 1 and 2 (8,192 slots) are both still allocated, and 258 is what's left.

`compute_swa_request_cap` already assumes those slots are gone by then. Under overlap it budgets two chunks plus one window (`chunks_in_flight = 2`), which is what is live when chunk N+1 is allocated while chunk N runs, once everything before chunk N's window has been freed. Without overlap it budgets one chunk, and the old order shrinks chunks there too (4096, 258, 3968, …; see the unit test).

## Modifications

- `mem_cache/common.py`: new `free_chunked_swa_before_plan()`. For a chunked request on an SWA cache that does not share prefixes (what `--disable-radix-cache` builds), it calls the cache's `evict_sliding_windows`, the same path `maybe_evict_swa` takes, with the same bound: `prefix_len`, and under overlap one chunk back (`prefix_len − chunked_prefill_size`, nothing before the third chunk), because the chunk in flight still reads the window before its start. It returns early for prefix-sharing caches and for a per-request SWA ring, whose chunks are not sized from the free count (`SWAPrefillBudget.available_chunk_tokens` skips `remaining_swa` for a ring).
- `managers/scheduler.py`: `_get_new_batch_prefill_raw` calls it before building the `PrefillAdder` whenever a chunked request is in progress. dLLM and PD disaggregation are skipped; I have not tested either.
- `environ.py`: `SGLANG_SWA_EVICT_BEFORE_CHUNK_PLAN` (default on). Setting it to 0 restores the old order. Happy to drop the flag if you'd rather not carry it.

So this frees exactly the slots `maybe_evict_swa` would free later in the same step, and that call then has nothing left to do. After a chunk cut short (e.g. by `shortest_prefill_chunk_limit`), that bound trails the chunk in flight, and what it frees is still enough: the slots held are then one chunk plus one window, which is what `compute_swa_request_cap` budgets. The unit test checks both.

## Accuracy Tests

The change moves chunk boundaries, so prompts longer than two chunks no longer get bit-identical output: different tokens share a forward. To check that the schedule is the only thing that changes, I ran a control: the old order with the SWA pool enlarged by one chunk, so the old planner produces the same full chunks. On the 127,852-token prompt the fix and the control gave identical output token ids and identical logprobs for all 64 output tokens, on each of two runs. Prompts that fit in two chunks were identical to the unpatched build.

This was tested end to end on a local build at `542a043` that also carries unrelated out-of-tree changes (a MoE expert offload path). Since then `main` has moved under the branch three times. The port onto `f92199b569` (2026-10-12) was the substantive one: #42822, #42824 and #42825 replaced `extend_range` and `Req.prefix_indices` with `prefix_len` / `extend_end`, and #43201 deleted `ChunkCache`. The latest rebase, onto `2c1e85964e` (2026-10-13), only resolved #43870's switch to `self.get_prefill_adder_class()`. The end-to-end run took the bound from the start of the chunk in flight; with full chunks that equals the bound above, which is what that run had at every step. The end-to-end numbers are from the original base; the unit test below was re-run on the new one.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MiMo-V2.6-Flash, one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, one request, 127,852-token prompt, two runs each:

| | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| prefill forwards | 60 | 32 |
| prefill throughput (tok/s) | 508 / 541 | 722 / 741 |
| end to end (s) | 253.9 / 238.7 | 179.5 / 174.9 |
| decode, short prompts (tok/s) | 32.74 | 32.73 |

This box streams MoE experts from host memory and SSD (out of tree), so the absolute throughput is not representative. The forward count is the part that carries over.

## Unit test

`test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_swa_evict_before_chunk_plan.py` runs on CPU. It drives one 33,644-token request through the real `SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator`, `UnifiedRadixCache` with `disable=True` (what `--disable-radix-cache` builds for a hybrid SWA model), `PrefillAdder.add_chunked_req` and `ScheduleBatch.maybe_evict_swa`, at the pool size `compute_swa_request_cap` gives (chunk 4096, window 128, page size 1, one running request):

- old order, overlap: 4096, 4096, then 258 and 3968 alternating (the sequence we saw in production);
- this change, with and without overlap: 8 × 4096 + 876, and with the third chunk cut to 1,000 tokens, 4096, 4096, 1000, 5 × 4096, 3972;
- after each early free, every slot the in-flight chunk reads is still mapped in the SWA pool, and the full pool is untouched;
- the `maybe_evict_swa` in `alloc_for_extend` then finds nothing left to free;
- a prefix-sharing cache, an SWA ring, a request without KV, and the first chunk in flight under overlap are each left alone (each case starts from a continuing request, so only the check under test can stop the free).

The test fails for each of eight mutations: no early free; the in-flight chunk's end as the bound; overlap ignored; a bound one chunk further back than `maybe_evict_swa`'s; and each of the four checks above removed. Upstream's unit tests that touch these paths (28 files, 3 of them on CUDA) give the same results as on `main`.

## Not covered

Page size > 1, several concurrent chunked or decoding requests, and the non-overlap path end to end (it is covered by the unit test only). The radix-cache path is unchanged, because the new function returns early for prefix-sharing caches; the scripted SWA chunked-prefill tests (`test_scripted_swa_1gpu.py`) run with the radix cache on, so they don't reach it.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit (ruff 0.15.1, isort 7.0.0, codespell 2.4.1 on the changed files).
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation: not changed. The flag is a kill switch, and the neighbouring `SGLANG_SWA_EVICTION_INTERVAL` is not documented either.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+def free_chunked_swa_before_plan(
+    req: Req,
+    *,
+    enable_overlap: bool,
+    tree_cache: BasePrefixCache,
+    token_to_kv_pool_allocator: BaseTokenToKVPoolAllocator,
+) -> None:
+    """Free a chunked prefill's out-of-window SWA slots before its next chunk is sized.
+
+    PrefillAdder sizes a continuing chunk from the SWA pool's free count, but
+    maybe_evict_swa frees these slots only later, in alloc_for_extend. At the pool
+    size compute_swa_request_cap gives (chunks in flight x chunk + window + slack),
+    every chunk after the second then alternates between the slack and
+    chunk - window tokens.

+    so this frees what alloc_for_extend would free, only earlier.
+    """
+    if not tree_cache.supports_swa() or tree_cache.supports_prefix_sharing():

+    if is_swa_req_ring(token_to_kv_pool_allocator):

+    if not req.kv.holds_kv:

@@ -0,0 +1,330 @@
+"""Chunk sizes of a long chunked prefill at the capped SWA pool.
+
+compute_swa_request_cap sizes the SWA pool for the chunks in flight plus one
+window and a small slack. PrefillAdder sizes a continuing chunk from the SWA
+free count, but maybe_evict_swa frees the previous chunk's out-of-window slots
+only afterwards, in alloc_for_extend, so every chunk after the second
+alternated between the slack and chunk - window tokens.
+free_chunked_swa_before_plan frees them before the chunk is sized.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from array import array
+from types import MethodType, SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req, ScheduleBatch
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_policy import PrefillAdder
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocator.swa import SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.cache_init_params import CacheInitParams
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.common import (
+    checkpoint_kv_cache,
+    free_chunked_swa_before_plan,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import ReqToTokenPool
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.swa_memory_pool import SWAKVPool
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.component_type import ComponentType
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_radix_cache import UnifiedRadixCache
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.pool_configurator import compute_swa_request_cap
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+CHUNK = 4096
+WINDOW = 128
+PROMPT_LEN = 8 * CHUNK + 876
+
+
+class _ChunkedPrefill:
+    """One request's chunked prefill, driven through the scheduler's steps on CPU:
+    stash the previous chunk, optionally free before planning, size the chunk
+    with PrefillAdder, then alloc_for_extend's maybe_evict_swa and allocation."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, enable_overlap: bool, evict_before_plan: bool):
+        self.enable_overlap = enable_overlap
+        self.evict_before_plan = evict_before_plan
+        self.swa_size = compute_swa_request_cap(
+            page_size=1, window=WINDOW, attn_dp_size=1
+        )
+        kvcache = SWAKVPool.__new__(SWAKVPool)
+        kvcache.full_kv_pool = None
+        kvcache.swa_kv_pool = None
+        kvcache.register_mapping = lambda mapping: None
+        self.allocator = SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator(
+            size=PROMPT_LEN,
+            size_swa=self.swa_size,
+            page_size=1,
+            dtype=torch.float16,
+            device="cpu",
+            kvcache=kvcache,
+            need_sort=False,
+        )
+        self.req_to_token_pool = ReqToTokenPool(
+            size=1,
+            max_context_len=PROMPT_LEN,
+            device="cpu",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+        )
+        # What --disable-radix-cache builds for a hybrid SWA model.
+        self.cache = UnifiedRadixCache(
+            CacheInitParams(
+                disable=True,
+                req_to_token_pool=self.req_to_token_pool,
+                token_to_kv_pool_allocator=self.allocator,
+                page_size=1,
+                sliding_window_size=WINDOW,
+                tree_components=(ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.SWA),
+            )
+        )
+        self.req = Req(
+            rid="long-prompt",
+            origin_input_text=None,
+            origin_input_ids=array("q", [1] * PROMPT_LEN),
+            sampling_params=SamplingParams(max_new_tokens=1),
+        )
+        self.req.init_next_round_input()
+        self.req.kv.req_pool_idx = 1
+        self.batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            tree_cache=self.cache,
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=self.allocator,
+            req_to_token_pool=self.req_to_token_pool,
+            reqs=[self.req],
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+            enable_overlap=enable_overlap,
+        )
+        self.batch._swa_eviction_trigger = MethodType(
+            ScheduleBatch._swa_eviction_trigger, self.batch
+        )
+        self.batch._evict_swa = MethodType(ScheduleBatch._evict_swa, self.batch)
+        # The start of the chunk planned last; under overlap it may still be running.
+        self.last_start = None
+        # SWA eviction cursor before and after each alloc-time maybe_evict_swa.
+        self.alloc_evictions = []
+
+    def evicted(self) -> int:
+        return self.req.kv.get_evicted_seqlen(ComponentType.SWA)
+
+    def run(self, after_early_free=None, chunk_limits=None):
+        # chunk_limits: {chunk index: limit}, as shortest_prefill_chunk_limit sets.
+        req = self.req
+        chunks = []
+        while True:
+            if chunks:
+                checkpoint_kv_cache(req, self.cache)
+                if self.evict_before_plan:
+                    free_chunked_swa_before_plan(
+                        req,
+                        enable_overlap=self.enable_overlap,
+                        tree_cache=self.cache,
+                        token_to_kv_pool_allocator=self.allocator,
+                    )
+                    if after_early_free is not None:
+                        after_early_free(self)
+
+            adder = PrefillAdder(
+                page_size=1,
+                tree_cache=self.cache,
+                token_to_kv_pool_allocator=self.allocator,
+                running_batch=None,
+                new_token_ratio=1.0,
+                rem_input_tokens=2 * PROMPT_LEN,
+                rem_chunk_tokens=CHUNK,
+            )
+            adder.chunked_req_limit = (chunk_limits or {}).get(len(chunks))
+            req.init_next_round_input()
+            unfinished = adder.add_chunked_req(req)
+            assert adder.can_run_list == [req], f"no chunk planned after {chunks}"
+
+            start, end = req.prefix_len, req.extend_end
+            self.batch.prefix_lens = [start]
+            before = self.evicted()
+            ScheduleBatch.maybe_evict_swa(self.batch)
+            self.alloc_evictions.append((before, self.evicted()))
+            loc = self.allocator.alloc(end - start)
+            assert loc is not None
+            self.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token[req.kv.req_pool_idx, start:end] = loc
+            req.extend_batch_idx += 1
+            self.last_start = start
+            chunks.append(end - start)
+            if unfinished is None:
+                return chunks
+
+
+class TestSWAEvictBeforeChunkPlan(CustomTestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _continuing_req(*, extend_batch_idx: int = 2):
+        # Past the request-level guards, so only the gate under test can stop the free.
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            prefix_len=2 * CHUNK,
+            extend_batch_idx=extend_batch_idx,
+            kv=SimpleNamespace(holds_kv=True),
+        )
+
+    def _assert_last_chunk_window_mapped(self, p, *, enable_overlap: bool) -> int:
+        # Under overlap the last chunk may still be running.
+        req = p.req
+        live_from = max(
+            (p.last_start if enable_overlap else req.prefix_len) - WINDOW, 0
+        )
+        rows = p.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token[req.kv.req_pool_idx]
+        live = rows[live_from : req.prefix_len]
+        self.assertTrue(bool((p.allocator.full_to_swa_index_mapping[live] > 0).all()))
+        self.assertEqual(p.allocator.full_available_size(), PROMPT_LEN - req.prefix_len)
+        return live_from
+
+    def _server_args(self, *, enable_overlap: bool):
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(
+            chunked_prefill_size=CHUNK,
+            max_running_requests=1,
+            disable_overlap_schedule=not enable_overlap,
+        )
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+    def _prefill(self, *, enable_overlap: bool, evict_before_plan: bool):
+        self._server_args(enable_overlap=enable_overlap)
+        return _ChunkedPrefill(
+            enable_overlap=enable_overlap, evict_before_plan=evict_before_plan
+        )
+
+    def test_old_order_shrinks_chunks_at_the_cap(self):
+        # Control: without the early free the harness reproduces the short chunks.
+        prefill = self._prefill(enable_overlap=True, evict_before_plan=False)
+        self.assertEqual(prefill.swa_size, 2 * CHUNK + 259)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            prefill.run(), [CHUNK, CHUNK] + [258, CHUNK - WINDOW] * 6 + [96]
+        )
+
+    def test_chunks_stay_full_at_the_cap(self):
+        for enable_overlap in (True, False):
+            with self.subTest(enable_overlap=enable_overlap):
+                prefill = self._prefill(
+                    enable_overlap=enable_overlap, evict_before_plan=True
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(prefill.run(), [CHUNK] * 8 + [876])
+
+    def test_early_free_keeps_what_the_last_chunk_reads(self):
+        for enable_overlap in (True, False):
+            with self.subTest(enable_overlap=enable_overlap):
+                prefill = self._prefill(
+                    enable_overlap=enable_overlap, evict_before_plan=True
+                )
+                bounds = []
+
+                def check(p):
+                    live_from = self._assert_last_chunk_window_mapped(
+                        p, enable_overlap=enable_overlap
+                    )
+                    bounds.append((p.evicted(), live_from))
+
+                prefill.run(after_early_free=check)
+                self.assertEqual(len(bounds), 8)
+                for evicted, live_from in bounds:
+                    self.assertEqual(evicted, live_from)
+
+    def test_chunks_stay_full_after_a_short_chunk(self):
+        # After a chunk cut short, maybe_evict_swa's overlap bound (one full chunk
+        # back) trails the chunk in flight; what it frees is still enough.
+        for enable_overlap in (True, False):
+            with self.subTest(enable_overlap=enable_overlap):
+                prefill = self._prefill(
+                    enable_overlap=enable_overlap, evict_before_plan=True
+                )
+                chunks = prefill.run(
+                    after_early_free=lambda p: self._assert_last_chunk_window_mapped(
+                        p, enable_overlap=enable_overlap
+                    ),
+                    chunk_limits={2: 1000},
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    chunks,
+                    [CHUNK, CHUNK, 1000]
+                    + [CHUNK] * 5
+                    + [PROMPT_LEN - 7 * CHUNK - 1000],
+                )
+
+    def test_alloc_for_extend_finds_nothing_left_to_free(self):
+        # The early free takes maybe_evict_swa's bound, so the alloc-time pass
+        # that used to free these slots now frees nothing.
+        for enable_overlap in (True, False):
+            with self.subTest(enable_overlap=enable_overlap):
+                prefill = self._prefill(
+                    enable_overlap=enable_overlap, evict_before_plan=True
+                )
+                prefill.run()
+                self.assertGreater(prefill.evicted(), 0)
+                for before, after in prefill.alloc_evictions:
+                    self.assertEqual(after, before)
+
+    def test_radix_cache_is_left_alone(self):
+        req = self._continuing_req()
+        cache = SimpleNamespace(
+            supports_swa=lambda: True, supports_prefix_sharing=lambda: True
+        )
+        allocator = SimpleNamespace(
+            free_group_begin=lambda: self.fail("freed from a radix cache")
+        )
+        free_chunked_swa_before_plan(
+            req,
+            enable_overlap=False,
+            tree_cache=cache,
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+        )
+
+    def test_swa_req_ring_is_left_alone(self):
+        # A per-request ring is not sized from the SWA free count.
+        req = self._continuing_req()
+        cache = SimpleNamespace(
+            supports_swa=lambda: True, supports_prefix_sharing=lambda: False
+        )
+        allocator = SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator.__new__(SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator)
+        allocator._swa_req_ring = True
+        allocator.free_group_begin = lambda: self.fail("freed from an SWA ring")
+        free_chunked_swa_before_plan(
+            req,
+            enable_overlap=False,
+            tree_cache=cache,
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+        )
+
+    def test_request_without_kv_is_left_alone(self):
+        req = self._continuing_req()
+        req.kv.holds_kv = False
+        cache = SimpleNamespace(
+            supports_swa=lambda: True, supports_prefix_sharing=lambda: False
+        )
+        allocator = SimpleNamespace(
+            free_group_begin=lambda: self.fail("freed for a request without KV")
+        )
+        free_chunked_swa_before_plan(
+            req,
+            enable_overlap=False,
+            tree_cache=cache,
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+        )
+
+    def test_first_chunk_in_flight_is_left_alone(self):
+        # Under overlap the first chunk may still be running, as in maybe_evict_swa.
+        self._server_args(enable_overlap=True)
+        req = self._continuing_req(extend_batch_idx=1)
+        cache = SimpleNamespace(
+            supports_swa=lambda: True, supports_prefix_sharing=lambda: False
+        )
+        allocator = SimpleNamespace(
+            free_group_begin=lambda: self.fail("freed under the first chunk")
+        )
+        free_chunked_swa_before_plan(
+            req,
+            enable_overlap=True,
+            tree_cache=cache,
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

issue_comments.body:
Ported onto `main` `f92199b569` and pushed (`ffe840c9ea`). `main` had moved under it again: your #42822, #42824 and #42825 replaced `extend_range` and `Req.prefix_indices` with `prefix_len` / `extend_end`, and #43201 deleted `ChunkCache`, which the test was built on.

- The bound is now `maybe_evict_swa`'s own: `prefix_len`, and under overlap `prefix_len − chunked_prefill_size`, with nothing freed before the third chunk. The previous version took the start of the chunk in flight, which isn't kept once that chunk is checkpointed. With full chunks the two are equal; after a chunk cut short this one frees less, and still enough (a new test case cuts the third chunk to 1,000 tokens, and the rest stay full). So the early free is the free `alloc_for_extend` would do in the same step, moved before the chunk is sized, and the test checks that `maybe_evict_swa` then finds nothing left.
- The test now runs on `UnifiedRadixCache(disable=True)`, which is what `--disable-radix-cache` builds for a hybrid SWA model.

The bug is still on `main`: the old-order control gives 4096, 4096, then 258 and 3968 alternating; with the change, 8 × 4096 + 876, with and without overlap. Each of eight mutations fails the test it targets. Upstream's unit tests that touch these paths (28 files, 3 of them on CUDA) give the same results as on `main`. Description updated.

@hnyls2002, since this now sits on your `prefix_len` refactor, could you take a look, and add `run-ci` if it looks right? I'm not in `CI_PERMISSIONS.json`.
